title: Minimum Stay Setting and the Minimum-Stay Floor — Listings Desk Reference
content:
# Minimum-Stay Floor and the Minimum Stay Setting

*Host Support card for Roamhaven Listings.*

## The policy this card serves

A listing's minimum stay may be no shorter than the listing's minimum-stay floor and no longer than the space type's minimum-night ceiling. A minimum stay standing below the floor is raised to the floor exactly, and the change is logged as one change of the minimum stay. A minimum stay at or above the floor is left as it stands.

| Minimum stay on the listing compared with the listing's minimum-stay floor | Handling |
|---|---|
| below the floor | raised to the floor exactly; one change of the minimum stay is logged |
| at the floor | left as it stands |
| above the floor (and no longer than the space type's minimum-night ceiling) | left as it stands |

**Effect of the change.** From the change onward, new bookings of the listing must be at least the new minimum stay; stays already booked are not touched. The host sees the new minimum stay on the listing.

## Support tool: `raise_minimum_stay_1aeaa300`

**Capability.** Overwrites the minimum stay of one host listing with the number of nights passed in. When the number differs from the minimum stay the listing carried at the moment of the call, one change record is added to the listing's history carrying the old and the new number of nights and today's date; an unchanged number logs nothing.

**How it is invoked.** The tool is an agent-side tool: support unlocks `raise_minimum_stay_1aeaa300` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `listing_id` | the reference number of the host listing whose minimum stay is set, as returned by the listing lookup for the verified host | the listing reference number |
| `minimum_nights` | the shortest stay new bookings may have, in nights | a non-negative integer — whole nights, no fractions |

**Return.** A receipt carrying `listing_id` (the listing reference number), `setting` (always `minimum_nights`), `previous_amount` (the minimum stay the listing carried when the call was made, in nights to 2 decimal places), `new_amount` (the minimum stay now saved, in nights to 2 decimal places), `change_logged` (true when a change record was added), `change_record_id` (the reference number of that record, empty when nothing was logged) and `saved_on` (the date of the save, YYYY-MM-DD). The call has completed when the receipt comes back with the listing reference number and the new number of nights; a receipt carrying the new number of nights means the minimum stay is in force.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

On a listing carrying a minimum stay of 1 night, a call with `minimum_nights` set to 3 returns `previous_amount` 1.00, `new_amount` 3.00 and `change_logged` true.
